findings.status: source-supported candidate; runtime reproduction pending with integration owner
findings.problem: ConnectUdpProxy::expand serializes port 0 without rejecting it. The shared HTTP/3 pool forwards that path through each selected CONNECT-UDP leg. RFC 9298 section 3 requires target_port in 1..65535.
trace: session/http3_pool.rs:38-78 preserves the endpoint port in Http3TransportTarget
route/connect_udp.rs:300-307 stringifies port without range validation
session/http3_pool.rs:121-206 validates path shape and HTTP request fields, not the UDP port variable
session/http3_pool.rs:706-896 constructs the chosen datagram route and starts its connector
findings.recommendation: Reject zero UDP target ports with the existing typed input/target error before proxy I/O. Add a quiet-peer zero-port negative control and 1/65535 positive controls for each applicable leg. Keep direct HTTP port-zero policy separate.

remaining_gaps: Full current request.rs/client.rs attempt, retry and redirect implementation was not reread in this pass; listed request.rs ranges are supporting partial reads only.

Live public SSE integration tests under crates/phantom/tests/streams/sse and the complete live CONNECT-UDP/proxy harness were not read here. The local unit tests reviewed here do not substitute for those contracts.
Full lower-layer CONNECT-UDP transport, stream/tunnel lease cancellation and all WebSocket operations remain outside this bounded pass; selected caller ranges are explicitly partial.
No runtime scheduling, idle timer race, reconnect cancellation, ready-stream fairness, network acceptance or actual proxy I/O claim follows from this source pass.
